description: Steer secrets through 1Password: block secrets pasted in chat (erased before Claude sees them), block commands/reads/writes that would leak or hard-code a secret, and stop Claude from asking the user to paste a secret. Python 3 (python3, or python if it is Python 3) must be on PATH; otherwise the hooks warn and fail open.

hooks.command: sh -c 'p=$(command -v python3 || command -v python) && "$p" -c "import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info[0] < 3)" && exec "$p" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard.py" prompt || { echo "op-secrets: the guard needs Python 3 on PATH (python3 or python); it is NOT running" >&2; exit 1; }'

sh -c 'p=$(command -v python3 || command -v python) && "$p" -c "import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info[0] < 3)" && exec "$p" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard.py" bash || { echo "op-secrets: the guard needs Python 3 on PATH (python3 or python); it is NOT running" >&2; exit 1; }'

sh -c 'p=$(command -v python3 || command -v python) && "$p" -c "import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info[0] < 3)" && exec "$p" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard.py" write || { echo "op-secrets: the guard needs Python 3 on PATH (python3 or python); it is NOT running" >&2; exit 1; }'

sh -c 'p=$(command -v python3 || command -v python) && "$p" -c "import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info[0] < 3)" && exec "$p" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard.py" read || { echo "op-secrets: the guard needs Python 3 on PATH (python3 or python); it is NOT running" >&2; exit 1; }'

sh -c 'p=$(command -v python3 || command -v python) && "$p" -c "import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info[0] < 3)" && exec "$p" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard.py" stop || { echo "op-secrets: the guard needs Python 3 on PATH (python3 or python); it is NOT running" >&2; exit 1; }'
